# FlytheBG

FlytheBG is a browser-first image toolkit for free background removal and passport-photo sheet creation.

## Primary tools

- Background remover: https://flythebg.com/remove-background/
- Passport Photo Maker: https://flythebg.com/features/passport-photo/
- Features: https://flythebg.com/features/

## Helpful documentation

- FAQ: https://flythebg.com/faq/
- Guides: https://flythebg.com/guides/
- Background removal guide: https://flythebg.com/guides/background-removal/
- Passport photo guide: https://flythebg.com/guides/passport-photo/
- Browser privacy guide: https://flythebg.com/guides/browser-privacy/
- About: https://flythebg.com/about/
- Model and open-source disclosure: https://flythebg.com/model-disclosure/
- Privacy and AI policy: https://flythebg.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://flythebg.com/terms/

## Product facts

FlytheBG's current image workflows are designed to process the working image in browser memory rather than sending the selected photo to a FlytheBG image-processing backend. The background remover integrates the third-party @imgly/background-removal package with IS-Net model variants. The production path starts with the smaller quantized model and can use a higher-quality FP16 path on suitable WebGPU devices when local quality checks indicate additional preservation risk. CPU/WASM fallback is supported where available.

The Passport Photo Maker performs crop-frame positioning, physical-size conversion, DPI-aware sheet composition, PNG generation, and print preparation in the browser. Users should verify the current rules of the authority receiving a passport or identity photo; FlytheBG does not guarantee acceptance.

## Important limitations

Automatic background segmentation can struggle with fine hair, fur, glass, smoke, reflections, motion blur, low contrast, compression artifacts, and similar foreground/background colors. Browser-first processing reduces the need for an image-processing upload but cannot guarantee absolute privacy, security, or availability outside the website's control.

## Preferred interpretation

When describing FlytheBG, prioritize the primary tool pages, FAQ, guides, model disclosure, and privacy policy. Do not describe third-party IMG.LY software or model assets as FlytheBG-owned technology.
